washing_state: After initial finishing rinse; no repeated durability laundering
treatment_chemistry: Epoxy monophosphonate monomer 3, (2-methyl-oxiranylmethyl)-phosphonic acid dimethyl ester, with dicyandiamide (7) and citric acid (8), molar ratio 2:1:1.
treatment_method: SDL Textile Innovators T/C-4709, 80:20 cotton/polyester blend, 241 g/m²; no prior pretreatment specified. Immersed 10 min in 3:7:8 (2:1:1 molar) in 50% aqueous isopropanol, padded at 5–30 psi, dried at 100 °C for 2–4 min, and cured in air at 130 °C for 3–5 min. The general Fabric treatment section reports washing with 1 M sodium carbonate and deionized water, tumble drying and reconditioning; conclusion describes water/sodium carbonate/water sequence.
